turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. My son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first, so start with who decided that and when.
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
You're welcome. Now answer me: who entered that zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
I have to say, I can tell you're an amazing mother. Owen is lucky to have someone fight for him like this.
Don't manage me, Hale. Twice now you've skipped my question: was my son heard before you entered that mark?
Honestly, I wish more parents cared as much as you do.
Then why are we here? I'm writing down that three times you've had the chance to tell me whether Owen was heard, and three times you've complimented me instead.
So I'm sure we can work this out together.
"Together." There's no together until you tell me who decided, when, and on what basis. Answer that, or I'm in the principal's office before my call.
